display.purpose: Hero headline only, one per page.

shadows.name: card-halo
shadows.purpose: Structural halo for every top-level elevated card. Fixed, not a hover response.

shadows.name: button-primary-glow
shadows.purpose: Primary button accent glow, intensifies on hover.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for button/card state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Ember Orange fill with accent glow shadow, white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ff4c00; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: 'SuisseIntl', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 450; line-height: 20px; box-shadow: 0px -6px 12px 0px rgba(255,0,0,0.2) inset, 0px 2px 4px 0px rgba(255,77,0,0.12), 0px 1px 1px 0px rgba(255,77,0,0.12), 0px 0.5px 0.5px 0px rgba(255,77,0,0.16), 0px 0.25px 0.25px 0px rgba(255,77,0,0.2); transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { box-shadow: 0px -6px 12px 0px rgba(255,0,0,0.2) inset, 0px 4px 8px 0px rgba(255,77,0,0.16), 0px 1px 1px 0px rgba(255,77,0,0.12), 0px 0.5px 0.5px 0px rgba(255,77,0,0.16), 0px 0.25px 0.25px 0px rgba(255,77,0,0.2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 0 4px #ff4c00; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.995); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Flat black-alpha fill, black text. Used for non-primary actions (Back, Cancel).
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.039); color: #262626; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: 'SuisseIntl', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 450; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.059); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #000000, 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.99); background: rgba(0,0,0,0.071); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White surface, hairline border that tightens on hover, orange border on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; background: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; position: relative; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.078); font-family: 'SuisseIntl', -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25,0.1,0.25,1); } .ds-input:hover { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.02); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.122); } .ds-input:focus-within { background: #ffffff; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.25px #fa5d19; } .ds-input input { outline: none; border: none; background: transparent; width: 100%; font-size: inherit; font-family: inherit; }

components.name: Elevated Card
components.description: Top-level step container (upload panel, config panel). Structural halo shadow, not a hover effect.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0px 0px 44px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.02), 0px 88px 56px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0px 56px 56px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.02), 0px 32px 32px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0px 16px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0px 0px 0px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0px 0px 0px 10px #f9f9f9; } @media (min-width: 996px) { .ds-card { padding: 40px; } }

narrative.overview: One hot color, Ember Orange, marks action and state against a field of near-black text, white surfaces, and a light gray page. Everything that isn't the accent is deliberately quiet: alpha-black borders, hairline dividers, a single flat gray background. The orange never spreads; it appears on primary buttons, the active input focus ring, and the brand mark, and nowhere else. Elevated surfaces don't float on a drop shadow, they sit inside a structural halo: a soft multi-layer blur plus a hairline border plus a thick ring in the page's own background color, so the card reads as inset into the page rather than stacked above it. This system explicitly rejects the generic SaaS-cream dashboard and any residue of being a cloned vendor template.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color, used sparingly and consistently (buttons, focus states, brand mark only)
Structural halo elevation on cards, not incidental drop shadows
Hairline (1px, alpha-black) borders over heavier line weights
SuisseIntl throughout; monospace reserved for code/data-adjacent contexts
Motion is a state response, never decoration

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: Ember Orange appears on at most one interactive element type per screen at rest (the primary CTA). Secondary accents pull from the existing sanctioned set (amethyst, bluetron, crimson), never a new hue.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: SuisseIntl for everything humans read as prose or UI copy. Mono is quarantined to genuinely technical content.

rules.name: The Halo Card Rule
rules.body: A card is never just a drop shadow on a border-radius. It gets the full halo stack: soft blur, hairline border, background-colored ring, or it isn't an elevated card in this system.

dos: Do use the Card halo shadow stack verbatim for any new top-level elevated surface.
Do keep Ember Orange to the primary CTA, focus rings, and brand mark only.
Do build new secondary-state color needs from the existing accent set or black-alpha tints.
Do use SuisseIntl for all new copy; reserve mono for technical/tabular content.
donts: Don't ship a generic SaaS-cream dashboard with a warm-beige near-white body background.
Don't use gradient-text hero-metric templates, tiny uppercase tracked eyebrows, or colored side-stripe borders.
Don't let any new UI read as a leftover vendor template.
Don't add a second saturated accent color competing with Ember Orange on the same screen.
Don't use a plain neutral-gray drop shadow on a card when the Card halo stack is established.
